component: Undefined colour class falls back to the accent (label-solid label-grey)
explanation: CaissaTrainer Phase 2 (training-overview.md F7). Article tags used label-solid label-grey; no label-grey class exists, so the solid fill fell back to the accent and rendered solid emerald blocks (probe: background rgb(16 185 129)). A product bug, not a rule, but a token lint that fails on unknown label or tone classes (or a component API that takes an enum instead of a class name) would have caught it, and it is the accent overuse that AP-012 describes. The screenshot is the dashboard after the neutral label change, as the article case has no rendered example.

classification.rationale: Application bug (unknown class). Generalizes only as an optional token or class lint, which the owner may decline. Suggestion only.
